visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The animation features a central orange tabby cat character from the popular Mochi Dad series. It is humorously dressed in a yellow snake-themed costume, including a coiled body and a hood that resembles a snake's head. The cat wears a small red traditional Chinese cap with a gold ornament. It has a neutral, slightly sleepy facial expression with half-closed eyes and a tiny white muzzle. The background is a solid festive red, adorned with gold traditional Chinese window lattice patterns. (2) The scene is designed as a seamless loop with subtle environmental movements. Warm white string lights bordering the frame flicker softly, while a small black charm wisp hanging from a string on the right side moves vertically up and down. A red celebratory banner hangs at the top with yellow Chinese calligraphy. At the bottom of the frame, several large gold sycee (yuanbao) are piled up. The lighting is flat and consistent across the 2D illustration.
